# SolveStack

SolveStack is a free, local-first IT troubleshooting workspace. It helps practitioners capture symptoms, observations, commands, evidence, hypotheses, dead ends, root causes, fixes, and validation while an investigation is in progress.

## Canonical pages

- https://solvestack-ai.app/ — product and workflow overview
- https://solvestack-ai.app/use-your-data/ — guide to turning exports into durable troubleshooting knowledge
- https://solvestack-ai.app/agent-adapter/ — bring-your-own agent pack protocol (redaction-first, no hosted model)
- https://solvestack-ai.app/rca-template/ — root cause analysis template for IT incidents
- https://solvestack-ai.app/5-whys-template/ — 5 whys template with a worked IT example
- https://solvestack-ai.app/fishbone-diagram-template/ — fishbone (Ishikawa) diagram template with the 6M categories, a worksheet, and a blank CSV
- https://solvestack-ai.app/incident-report-template/ — IT incident report template with a worked example
- https://solvestack-ai.app/vpn-outage-template/ — VPN outage troubleshooting template and checklist
- https://solvestack-ai.app/sign-in-failure-template/ — SSO sign-in failure troubleshooting template and checklist
- https://solvestack-ai.app/expired-certificate-template/ — expired certificate (TLS) troubleshooting template and checklist
- https://solvestack-ai.app/dns-failure-template/ — DNS failure troubleshooting template and checklist
- https://solvestack-ai.app/disk-full-template/ — disk full troubleshooting template and checklist
- https://solvestack-ai.app/email-delivery-template/ — email delivery failure troubleshooting template and checklist
- https://solvestack-ai.app/onenote-vs-solvestack/ - honest comparison of OneNote and SolveStack for IT troubleshooting notes, citing Microsoft support pages, with a sample SolveStack export

## Product boundaries

- Core data stays in IndexedDB in the current browser profile (large evidence may use OPFS).
- SolveStack has no account, cloud database, or built-in AI service.
- Method deep links: `/?method=rca`, `/?method=5-whys`, `/?method=fishbone`, `/?method=incident-report`.
- Users choose when to export Markdown, HTML, JSON, backups, ZIP knowledge packages, encrypted vaults, or redacted agent packs.
- Exported records should be redacted before they are shared with external tools.
